1.1: I was small among my brethren, And youngest in my father’s house: I tended my father’s sheep.
1.2: My hands formed a musical instrument, And my fingers tuned a psaltery.
1.3: And who shall tell my Lord? The Lord himself, he himself heareth.
1.4: He sent forth his angel, And took me from my father’s sheep, And he anointed me with the oil of his anointing.
1.5: My brethren were handsome and tall; But the Lord did not take pleasure in them.
1.6: I went forth to meet the Philistine; And he cursed me by his idols.
1.7: But I drew his own sword, and beheaded him, And removed reproach from the children of Israel.
